segment.source: How the control applies algorithms: Unspecified, Disabled, Global, or Custom.
segment.target: 控件算法模式：Unspecified、Disabled、Global 或 Custom。

segment.source: Ordered ThemeAlgorithm values used only when Algorithm is Custom.
segment.target: 仅在 Algorithm 为 Custom 时使用的有序 ThemeAlgorithm 枚举值。

segment.source: Global Token and Own Token overrides applied only to the selected Control identity.
segment.target: 仅应用到目标 Control identity 的 Global Token 与 Own Token 覆盖。

segment.source: Ordered ThemeAlgorithm values. A null value inherits the parent algorithm chain.
segment.target: 有序的 ThemeAlgorithm 枚举值；null 表示继承父级算法链。

segment.source: Control theme configurations keyed by ControlTokenIdentity.
segment.target: 按 ControlTokenIdentity 索引的控件主题配置。

segment.source: Whether this configuration inherits and merges the parent theme configuration.
segment.target: 是否继承并合并父级主题配置。

segment.source: Immutable scoped theme configuration. Runtime updates replace the complete value.
segment.target: 不可变的局部主题配置；运行期更新需要替换完整配置值。

segment.source: Global token overrides keyed by token name.
segment.target: 按 Token 名称索引的全局 Token 覆盖。

segment.source: Every publicly themeable Control has an independent identity. Its configuration can override any Global Token and that Control's Own Tokens; the overrides affect only the selected Control and do not leak to other Controls.
segment.target: 每个对外可主题化的控件都有独立 Control identity。可以在该控件配置下覆盖任意 Global Token 以及该控件的 Own Token；覆盖只影响目标控件，不会泄漏到其他控件。

segment.source: By modifying token property of theme, we can modify Design Token globally. Some tokens will affect other tokens. We call these tokens Seed Token.
segment.target: 通过修改主题的 token 属性，可以全局修改 Design Token。部分 token 会影响其他 token，这类 token 称为 Seed Token。

segment.source: By nesting ConfigProvider you can apply a local theme to part of your page. Design Tokens that are not changed in the child theme inherit from the parent theme.
segment.target: 通过嵌套 ConfigProvider，可以为页面的局部区域应用局部主题。子主题中未修改的 Design Token 会继承父主题。

segment.source: Customize Theme demonstrates how ThemeConfigProvider overrides Global Tokens, applies preset algorithms, configures Control Tokens, and nests theme contexts without changing the global application theme.
segment.target: Customize Theme 展示 ThemeConfigProvider 如何覆盖 Global Token、应用预设算法、配置控件 Token 和嵌套主题上下文，而不需要修改应用全局主题。

segment.source: Customize AtomUI themes with Global Tokens, algorithms, Control Tokens, and nested local theme scopes.
segment.target: 通过 Global Token、算法、控件 Token 和局部嵌套作用域定制 AtomUI 主题。

segment.source: Themes with different styles can be quickly generated by modifying algorithm. Ant Design 5.0 provides three sets of preset algorithms by default: DefaultAlgorithm, DarkAlgorithm, CompactAlgorithm.
segment.target: 通过修改 algorithm 可以快速生成不同风格的主题。Ant Design 5.0 默认提供三套预设算法：DefaultAlgorithm、DarkAlgorithm、CompactAlgorithm。

segment.source: Replace ThemeConfigProvider.Config with a new immutable ThemeConfig to publish one scoped snapshot without adding resource provider layers.
segment.target: 使用新的不可变 ThemeConfig 替换 ThemeConfigProvider.Config，即可发布一个局部 Snapshot，并且不会追加资源 Provider 层。
